head: codex/5589-runtime-v3-parity-c
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3] Add governed operations adapters
body:
Closes #5589

Adds Runtime v3 Parity-C governed operations with signed Freedom Gate/AEE authority, attenuating delegation, resident Agent/Shepherd/Scheduler execution, bounded provider process I/O and process-tree cancellation, governed tool containment, identity-scoped authenticated continuity, signed appeal disposition, cross-process shutdown ordering, and bounded replay/state.

Validation: 28 exact inventory-guarded Parity-C tests; full Runtime v3 all-target suite with 242 discovered tests and all non-ignored tests green; strict all-target Clippy; formatting and diff hygiene. Exact review accepted the functionally necessary, non-duplicative +1,096 source delta over the authoritative post-#5591 baseline of 12,683.
